history: Mizan Terminology Glossary — append-only version history. Entries are never deleted or rewritten in place; each change appends a new version record.

versions.change: Seed established at birth: 12 core Murabaha terms of art (G-001..G-012), each status locked-pending-calibration, grounded in Input #2.

Growth protocol demonstration: encountered unseeded term بيع التولية; researched on demand against public authoritative sources; appended G-013 with status provisional; routed to the consolidated Arabic review list. No collision with any locked rendering.

Principal calibration applied: all items on the Arabic review list ACCEPTED as-is. Lifecycle status flipped to 'locked' for seed G-001..G-012 (from locked-pending-calibration) and for growth-protocol G-013 (from provisional). Schema migration (registry-wide): the provenance axis was relabelled from 'established_or_provisional' (established|provisional) to 'grounding_basis' (grounded|unverified) and the container unified to 'provenance', so the rule-status word 'established' can no longer be confused with a sourcing label. G-013 grounding_basis set to 'unverified' (tertiary web glossaries). No entries added or removed; no rendering changed.

Stage 2 growth protocol: encountered Ijara terms of art while grounding the Ijara rule-set (Input #3); researched against the grounding report; appended G-014..G-022 with status provisional, grounding_basis grounded; routed to the Stage-2 consolidated Arabic review list. No collision with any locked rendering.
